facts: This paper describes the framework of a Korean phonological knowledge base system.
The framework uses the unification-based grammar formalism.
Korean Phonology Structure Grammar is abbreviated as KPSG.
The approach of KPSG provides an explicit development model.
The explicit development model is for constructing a computational phonological system.
The computational phonological system is a speech recognition and synthesis system.
The proposed approach is more describable than other approaches.
Other approaches include those employing a traditional generative phonological approach.
